description: Semantic LLM judge that evaluates the entire campaign package against the BAE Estate Model thesis. Catches packaging violations that structural gates cannot: wrong hub-spoke routing, Post Hub summarizing instead of hooking, Article missing Substack CTA, platform-non-native copy, weak Estate narrative flow. Uses OAuth CLI (claude → gemini → codex fallback) — no API key required.
litmus: Run HOW.py with campaign_file — exit 0=Estate model correctly implemented, exit 1=BLOCK (hard violation), exit 2=WARN (advisory or CI mode).

files.PROMPT.md: Judge prompt encoding Estate model rules — fed to claude -p along with campaign package
files.HOW.py: Collects campaign.json + all content files, pipes to CLI judge, returns structured verdict
files.AUDIT.py: Compliance scan — surfaces past BLOCK events from enforcement log
files.WATCH.py: Evolution scanner — signals strengthen if block_rate > 40% (Estate model not internalized)

estate_model.chain: Spoke → Post Hub → Article SEO Hub → Substack

origin_incident: 2026-05-07: other agent acknowledged Ground Zero miss — April 22-23 reviews were per-content quality checks; no judge ever evaluated the whole campaign package against the Estate thesis before human review.
